description: Run the project's own TypeScript (`tsc --noEmit`) and return the type errors about three.js, each with the answer from the installed release: the member that does exist (did you mean), where a name is really exported from ('three' or 'three/addons/...'), removed paths, and a note when @types/three is a different release than three. `all: true` lists the other type errors too. Needs typescript and a tsconfig.json in the project; for JavaScript use three_review. Read-only (tsc runs with --noEmit).

path.description: Project folder, or a file or folder in it (relative to the server's folder; default: the project).

three.description: Path to a three package folder, when it is not in node_modules above the project.

name: three_types
title: Type-check a TypeScript three.js project
